changes.reason: Changes how a Node RSC production-build document carries its Flight payload: the build worker streams it into the HTML between React flushes, the client entry loads as an async React bootstrap module, and readRscInitialFlight() reads the blocks as they arrive, so the shell hydrates before late Suspense boundaries resolve.

kubernetes.reason: A Vite RSC fixture served by @hono/node-server through createNodeComposedHandler, RenderServer and loadRscBuild sends the shell, the async client entry and the shell's Flight blocks over real HTTP while a boundary is held in the build's worker, then the late HTML, its Flight and the end block after release.
constraints: The worker reads one HTML chunk ahead to find React flush ends and reads Flight eagerly; memory per document stays bounded by its Flight payload.
A proxy in front of the server must stream responses instead of buffering them, or the shell hydrates only when the document ends.
Local host-runtime evidence does not certify a deployed Kubernetes cluster.

evidence.testName: Node RSC production build host sends the shell, the client entry and the shell's Flight before a held boundary resolves
